description: List every US state/city that Angi publishes pages for, for one trade. Use it to confirm a city slug exists before searching, or to discover nearby cities. Reads Angi's public sitemap directly — no browser bridge required.

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the city slug.

state.description: Restrict to one two-letter state code, e.g. "nc".

name: angi_list_cities
